about.title: How it works
about.intro: RetinaEdge takes one retinal photo and turns it into a clear next step for the patient. Every stage runs on this machine. No image leaves the device.
about.pipe.photo.text: A fundus photo from a camera or a file.
about.pipe.quality.text: Checks field, centering, sharpness, glare, exposure and contrast. A failed check is ungradable, never No DR.
about.pipe.grader.text: A convolutional network scores the retina on the five-step ICDR scale.
about.pipe.lesions.text: A segmentation model marks microaneurysms, haemorrhages, exudates and cotton wool spots as visible evidence.
about.pipe.decision.text: Grade, confidence, lesion counts and photo quality combine into one of four tiers.
about.pipe.sheet.text: A printable sheet in the patient's language with the follow-up date and a QR code.
about.tiersNote: Uncertain results go to a second-look queue for a trained grader. Photos that fail the quality check are sent back for a retake.
about.noValMetrics: No validation metrics recorded for this model file.
about.qualityText: The quality coach is deterministic image processing, not a neural network. It measures the things that make fundus photos ungradable in the field and turns each into a specific instruction for the health worker.
about.disclaimer: Research prototype. Not a medical device. Not clinically validated. Results support a health worker's decision to refer; they do not diagnose.
quality.noLens: Retinal lens not detected. This image may have low accuracy.
photo.live.hint: Live coaching runs on every frame. Capture is enabled when the light is green or yellow.
about.qualityLearned: The quality coach is a trained multi-label classifier (MobileNetV3) that flags: not a retinal image, no retinal lens, blur, glare, too dark, over-exposed, off-centre. It was trained on real fundus photos with controlled degradations plus real non-retinal photographs, so every label is exact. Deterministic image measurements still drive the metric bars and the field circle.
about.qualityRules: The quality coach model is not installed on this device, so deterministic image processing rules are used instead. They measure the things that make fundus photos ungradable in the field and turn each into an instruction for the health worker.
about.confusion: Confusion matrix (rows: true grade, columns: predicted)
